note: Initial hypothesis, not a validated model (spec section 5). Change weights only after held-out evaluation.
s_combination: weighted arithmetic mean of the available normalized S components; weights renormalized over those present
s_b_normalization: mid-rank percentile of S_B bits over the evaluation pool; controls are placed on the pool's distribution
r_combination: weighted geometric mean of the available relevance dimensions, weights normalized to sum to 1; U is unavailable in v1 and omitted

relevance_gate.rule: a candidate below either floor keeps its RSS but ranks after every candidate that passes

eligibility: evidence gate from candidates.jsonl eligibility.eligible (Ripple's existing rules); ineligible candidates keep their RSS and rank after eligible ones

missing_rules.S: renormalize over the S components present; S is missing only if none is present
missing_rules.R: renormalize over the relevance dimensions present; R is missing if a required dimension (C) is missing
missing_rules.RSS: missing when S or R is missing; unscored candidates rank after scored ones and are never treated as zero

dedupe.rule: within one catalyst group, candidates in the same manual cluster or with outcome-token Jaccard at or above jaccard_min are one discovery; the best-ranked one stands and the rest are marked duplicate_of and moved after the non-duplicates. RSS itself is unchanged.
